# SJR – SCImago Journal & Country Rank
##  Ranking of Scientific Journals and Research Output by Country
[ Learn more](https://www.scimagolab.com/products/sjr-scimago-journal-country-rank/#form-quote) [ Request a quote](https://www.scimagolab.com/products/sjr-scimago-journal-country-rank/#form-quote)
## **What is the SJR?**
An Open Access web platform that allows users to analyze two rankings: “Journal Rankings” and “Country Rankings,” both based on journal output
## Journal Rankings
A fully open access platform providing researchers, editors, and the public **scientometric indicators** and **journal quartiles** , categorized by region, country, and subject area. It also offers tools to help users **understand journal performance** through indicator comparison, co-authorship network mapping, and ranking identification within the scientific landscape.
[See Journal Rankings](https://www.scimagojr.com/journalrank.php)
## Country Rankings
Enables users to**identify the role of scientific journals** published by institutions in each country in generating new knowledge. The platform **provides scientometric indicators** of journal output, benchmarking against other **countries and world regions** , as well as insights into strengths by subject area and the rate of Open Access output. Additionally, it offers **two tools** that help to:
  * **Visually explore the scientific productivity** and performance of a country by subject area and over different time periods
  * **Analyze global scientific output** , or that of any of the eight **world regions** , through detailed reports tracking their performance through scientometric indicators.


[See Country Rankings](https://www.scimagojr.com/countryrank.php)
## **Goals**
The Journal Rankings and Country Rankings provides:
  * **Open access of scientometric indicators** for scientific journals
  * A clear view of how **scientific communications** work within each **country**


  * **Visibility and international ranking** of scientific journals
  * Analytical tools for **scientific output** and communication


## **Features and Functionalities**
of the SJR – SCImago Journal & Country Rank
### FEATURES
  * Open access ranking
  * Catalogue of the world’s leading **scientific journals**
  * Extensive data and **metrics** on scientific output from countries and regions across the **globe**
  * An annual ranking derived from **performance data** covering a four-year span, ending one year before publication.
  * **Standardized data** through a tool able to identify and **disambiguate journals** , **authors** , and **institutions** , enabling an unique journal identification and an accurate citation attribution


### FUNCTIONALITIES
  * The **platform features** two separate rankings (for countries and journals) that **can be cross-referenced and compared**
  * Specific **geographic areas** can be analyzed within each country category.
  * All data is visually represented using **interactive graphical** displays.
  * Supplementary information is provided to assist **non-specialist users in interpreting the graphs** and understanding their data
  * Journals can display **their quartile ranking** on their websites using a provided **embed code**(a popular feature).
  * All **ranking** **data** can be **downloaded in an Excel format**


[Further information](https://www.scimagolab.com/products/sjr-scimago-journal-country-rank/#form-quote)
[Access to SJR](https://www.scimagojr.com/)
## **Advantages of the SJR – SCImago Journal & Country Rank**
We deliver tailored solutions and meaningful value to our users.
![](https://www.scimagolab.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/12/ico-revista-sq.svg)
### Publishers and editors
  * Understand the **quartile rankings** of their **publications**.
  * Visualize **trends** in additional **scientometric indicators over time.**
  * **Compare** their indicators **against** those of **competing journals**
  * Use our comments section to **interact directly with users**
  * Inclusion in the ranking enhances the likelihood of attracting **higher-quality** submissions and generating **more citations** from indexed journals.


![](https://www.scimagolab.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/12/ico-investigador-sq.svg)
### Researchers
  * Discover **Scopus-indexed journals** on a specific **topic** for potential submissions
  * Identify the quartile and scientometric indicators that **best suit their article**
  * **Compare** the performance of scientific journals
  * Access the**journal’s** website and **contact** its **editors**
  * Engage directly with the **SCImago team** and connect with **journal teams** via the **comments** feature (we forward comments to editors and encourage them to use our platform for inquiries).


![](https://www.scimagolab.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/12/ico-universidad-sq.svg)
### Universities
  * Identify the journals that will help strengthen the **impact** of the **institution’s scientific output**
  * Use journal and country scientometric indicators to establish **policies** for **promoting research**
  * Understand the **status** of **journals** in their **country** and those of their **competitors**


![](https://www.scimagolab.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/12/ico-niversidad-sq.svg)
### Governments
  * Use the scientific output **reports** to **set goals** and guide public policies aimed at strengthening **scientific institutions**


![](https://www.scimagolab.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/12/ico-centro-investogacion-sq.svg)
### Research Centers
  * **Identify trends** in **scientific communication** within their **discipline** and **research focus** , along with the **research areas** being explored by top-ranked journals.


[Further information](https://www.scimagolab.com/products/sjr-scimago-journal-country-rank/#form-quote)
[Access to SJR](https://www.scimagojr.com/)
